- A short note on SLAs and fallback behavior if the dedicated pool is constrained (so we can present to finance).

Procurement team —

Attached is an editable PO draft and the proposed acceptance schedule (see VG_Acceptance_Schedule.xlsx). Highlights:
- Tranche 1 acceptance: 2027-01-04 (initial 2x capacity)
- Tranche 2 acceptance: 2027-04-04 (ramp to 4x capacity)
- Tranche 3 acceptance: 2027-07-04 (sustained 4x+ with option to burst)
- We will issue separate invoices per tranche; charges prorated to the day if acceptance falls mid-invoice period.
- SLA fallback: automatic routing to a compatible shared model with a 90-second degrade notice window; any sustained outage beyond 15 minutes triggers crediting per SLA table in exhibit A.

Next steps for VectorGrid:
1) Procurement: confirm acceptance dates and billing addresses.
2) Legal (Kimberly): propose any redlines to the SLA/fallback language by 11/19 so we can package a final PO for signature.
3) VectorGrid: sign via DocuSign link we will provide once final PO is confirmed.

Attachments in this thread (editable stubs): Redwood_PO_Draft_20261114.pdf; VG_Acceptance_Schedule.xlsx; SOC2_Summary_2026-10.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if that speeds things up.

Diego
